Messages.Author: Michael Kelly
Messages.Body:
I recently played in a game and it came out that my group
believes that if multiple players are ousted the oustings
are resolved in order rather than simultaneous. In other
words they believe that if you ouste your prey and grand-
prey with a single vote you get 12 pool and 2 VP. Of
course I know this is wrong, but they claim that the Duelist
said that this was the case and that nothing has been printed
to contradict this. My claims that the people and WOTC rep
on the newsgroup said otherwise only earned me a few
ridiculing laughs. Is there anywhere other than the newsgroup
I can go to prove my case and redeem my honor? Or must I
suffer erroneus playing since WOTC never had the time to
add such unimportant things as V:tES errata to the duelist.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


There is no such article, to the best of my knowledge and to
Shawn's knowledge.

If they can quote issue and page references, please pass that
information along.

Otherwise, the rules in the rulebook still hold - you don't
even have to fall back on the mysterious internet :-)

(i.e., simultaneous ousting of your prey and grand-prey
result in the prey getting a VP and in you getting six pool
and a VP).
